meta.project: Orderlly Admin Backend API & Database Specification

product_overview: Orderlly Admin Backend is a secure Node.js/Express/PostgreSQL service for restaurant owners and managers to administer restaurant operations. It provides authenticated, role-based, tenant- and branch-isolated APIs for dashboard reporting and core management workflows.
core_goals: Authenticate users securely with JWT-based login and token handling
Enforce RBAC, tenant isolation, and branch isolation on every protected endpoint
Provide performant dashboard and administrative APIs for restaurant operations
Maintain API validation, database integrity, and consistent error handling
Support audit logging, monitoring, and production-ready backend reliability

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to log in securely and obtain access to protected admin APIs.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/login with invalid email or password -> Receive 400 Bad Request or 401 Unauthorized with error details

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Returns summarized operational data for authorized owners and managers.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/dashboard with a valid JWT and authorized role -> Receive 200 with dashboard data
GET /api/admin/dashboard without a JWT or with insufficient permissions -> Receive 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden
